quotes.summary_phrase: Shawn Marion on the difficulty of reaching 10,000 career rebounds
quotes.excerpt: for a guy considered a small forward, to get 10,000 rebounds is really not realistic.
quotes.quote: One of the biggest ones I said, 10,000 career rebounds. That one was crazy and I didn't think about it for a small forward. For a guy considered a small forward, to get 10,000 rebounds is really not realistic. That was one that was like, wow, I was like, man, 10,000 rebounds, really? I was a rebounding fool, what the.

quotes.speaker: Shawn Marion
quotes.summary_phrase: Shawn Marion on his long-standing friendship with Tyson Chandler
quotes.excerpt: I've been through a part of his whole journey. It's crazy. I've been knowing you that long.

text_blocks.speaker: Dana Larson
text_blocks.text: How about Tyson, because you guys obviously share a great bond, but also go way back. Is it as far back as high school?

text_blocks.speaker: Shawn Marion
text_blocks.text: It is high school for him, because I'm older than Tyson, of course. I've been through a part of his whole journey. It's crazy. I've been knowing you that long and it was a great teammate and it's been great to be friends with him over the years.

quotes.speaker: Shawn Marion
quotes.summary_phrase: Shawn Marion on the 2011 Mavericks championship run
quotes.excerpt: I think it's one of the best runs in NBA history by far.
quotes.quote: I think the sacrifice that we all just locked in and man, it was an emotional time. Every time you get a chance to really reflect from Portland to Lakers to OKC and then to Miami Heat, I think it's one of the best runs in NBA history by far.

quotes.summary_phrase: Shawn Marion on the importance of fan connection in sports
quotes.excerpt: when you actually put the fan head on and actually invest into a team, you really truly feel
quotes.quote: When you actually put the fan head on and actually invest into a team, you really truly feel the compassion that fans have. I think I've done that with a lot of the teams I support.
